save.text: Episode number: 47 tonight; 50th episode upcoming in three episodes; Critmas after 50th. (confirmed by MATT, turn 66)
Sam announced he's voice directing a DreamWorks cartoon 'Home'—show announced, coming in a week. (SAM, turn 63)
Gilmore's Glorious Goods shirts pre-order deadline ambiguous: Travis says 'tomorrow at midnight' (turn 28); confusion among cast—MATT advises to order tonight to be safe. (turns 28, 41, 42, 44)
Marisha's last episode of Signal Boost this Tuesday; she rotates hosts but remains producer and won't fully relinquish control. (MARISHA, turns 76–87)
Liam is physically in the kitchen he grew up in and is playing D&D there. (LIAM, turn 94)
Gern Blanston left the group after the battle and went back into the Cindergrove to collect red dragon scales; he has not been seen since. (MATT, turn 114)

Scanlan casts Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion, creates a pocket-planar mansion; confirmed items used (ivory door, marble, silver spoon) and singing; servants/attendants appear; mansion can hold creatures designated when cast (Matt, turns 141–152,159–166,189–193).
Scanlan offers lodging to the Pyrah tribe and refugees; Matt states ~35 Pyrah including Zephrah; tribe hesitates and continues building shelters (Sam, Matt, turns 165–187).
Travis (Grog) attacks the mansion's ethereal servants with Craven Edge; servants' energy disperses and items drop (Travis, Matt, turns 194–199).

Scanlan's mansion servants are supernatural/ghost-like but serve willingly; Scanlan claims 100 servants (50 personal, others available). He demonstrated ordering tasks (braiding chest hair, bringing wine) and rooms upstairs; mentioned rooms for Pike and 'Kaylie' near his. (turns 212–223, 249–259, 268–276)

Scanlan's Mordenkainen mansion: door is invitation-only; can be cast once per day; casting time 1 minute; servants are summonable (at least five visible) and can fetch items; servants can bring a single spectral cow (ghost cow) but lack arbitrary resources (can't fetch a squid). Scanlan forgot a Trinket room; provided basement training room and third pantry exists but full. (turns 279–356)

Servants are nonlethal/insubstantial: spectral cow has weight but leaves no blood and can disperse; servants obey simple commands and perform tasks (braid hair, fetch wine, fetch cow). (turns 320–350)
Keyleth returned with a few Pyrah tribe stragglers into the mansion; some remain building shelters outside for future use; party offered to rest for evening. (turn 279)
Basement training room discovered: sand pit, training dummies, chains, weapons rack, armor set. (MATT, turn 360)

Trinket trained in basement; ran and attacked Grog (attack +8, hit 23) dealing 7 bludgeoning; Grog held and succeeded Strength save (26), knocked prone but unhurt otherwise. (MATT/LAURA/TRAVIS, turns 384–396)
Vex absent during training; Trinket became antsy and left to seek her. (MATT, turn 434)
Broom from Gern is enchanted; requires a spoken phrase to activate—runes hide an archaic Draconic word meaning 'candle' which, when spoken/recognized, causes broom to fly. (Turns 492–523)
Scanlan can identify magic and made Investigation check (21) to find hidden script; lacks Identify spell. (SAM/MATT, turns 493–498, 494)
Vex/Laura used the broom; when 'candle' phrase discovered broom briefly lifted her (Turn 523–525).

Laura (Vex) activated enchanted broom saying archaic Draconic word 'candle' and flew around room; succeeded Dex check (20) despite exhaustion; room is extradimensional ~50 ft ceilings. (Turns 542–555, 548–552, 535)
Scanlan/Scanlan's troupe reacted: Scanlan offered moral support, suggested repaying Gern's debt and tracking/choosing someone for Laura to help later; Scanlan will 'mark that down'. (Turns 558–570)
Later that night Cerkonos visited Keyleth (Marisha); his previously burned-off arm is visibly regenerating but he keeps it covered; he entered saying he was uneasy and asked to sit. (Turns 593–601)

Cerkonos told Keyleth about a girl named Raishan who came to Pyrah ~4 yrs ago for redemption, learned there, later grew distant, opened the Gate using ancient arcane powers, and may be responsible for Thordak's emergence; she was ~15 on arrival and 'seemed human'. (MATT, turns 603–621)
Keyleth recognizes the name Raishan as used during the Conclave attack on Emon and associated with the green dragon that initiated that assault. (MATT, turns 631–632)
Cerkonos's burned-off arm is visibly regenerating but he keeps it covered; he showed unease when speaking with Keyleth. (Earlier note confirmed in this scene; MATT, turns 592–601, 625)

Vex (Laura) admits she stole an enchanted broom from Gern and kept it; group debated leaving items in mansion storage to test persistence; Trinket present at breakfast. (Turns 662–676, 670–675, 523–525)
Group discussed moral/ownership concerns; Scanlan suggested testing storage with items (Trinket, broom). Vex intends to keep the broom; Percy's reaction solicited. (Turns 662–672, 708–714)

Vex (Laura) actively practices flying broom in breakfast room; fired arrows while airborne (attack with disadvantage: one hit into turkey, one missed). She floats down and remains hovering eye-level; vows to practice and have Percy build a seat; offers Percy money for work. (LAURA/MATT/TALIESIN, turns 715–803)

Laura (Vex) activated enchanted broom saying archaic Draconic word 'candle' and flew around room; succeeded Dex check (20) despite exhaustion; room is extradimensional ~50 ft ceilings. Later she flew again during breakfast and performed aerial archery with mixed success (one hit, one miss). (Turns 542–555, 548–552, 523, 715–753)

Cerkonos told Keyleth Raishan came to Pyrah ~4 years ago posing as a ~15-year-old human woman, was adopted by Fire Ashari, later opened the rift and likely connected to Thordak; she left for Emon. (MARISHA, turns 819–841)
Keyleth/party recognize Raishan as a dragon/infiltrator linked to the Conclave attack on Emon; party confirms Raishan as instigator/close to Thordak. (Turns 822–834, 852–857)

Party plans/options discussed: retrieve Titanstone Knuckles (with Kevdak/tribe), consult sphinx in Whitestone (sphinx's 'boyfriend'), or visit library; Grog's family reunion mentioned. (Turns 875–892)
Party plans to head toward Westruun area (west of Westruun along Silvercut Roadway) to seek Grog's herd and/or Frostweald; decision leans toward visiting Grog's herd. (Turns 892–920, 912–919)

Grog's herd size ~6 (party and Grog confirm 'six'). Herd wanders Silvercut Roadway; they likely hold Titanstone Knuckles and are proud owners—unlikely to willingly give them up. (Turns 964–971, 920, 962–963)

Party discusses stealth/avoidance options: using Hat of Disguise on Grog or disguise tactics; Keyleth/Trinket/wolf-tracking and Whitestone wolf as tracking options; Grog insists he won't hide from his herd. (Turns 940–951, 955–958, 943–946)

Party plans: prioritize retrieving Titanstone Knuckles (possibly one-on-one), then consult sphinx in Frostweald; consider Cobalt Reserve in Westruun already looted by Allura. (Turns 1014–1021, 1018–1020, 1015–1017)

Decision: head to the Frostweald/sphinx next; Marisha can scry for a tree or fly group on Vex's broom; Marisha failed an Intelligence check (9) to recall specific Frostweald trees. (Turns 1033–1048, 1038–1040, 1044–1046)
Westruun status: under dragon control; a black dragon (Umbrasyl) occupies Gatshadow north of Westruun/Cloudkeep; Gatshadow linked to Grog's scar. (Turns 1011–1014, 1012–1013)
Party used Wind Walk (mist form) to travel through Bramblewood toward Frostweald; travel time ~<day on horseback, ~2+ days on foot). (MATT/MARISHA, turns 1112–1116)
Keyleth successfully scryed/linked to a specific Bramblewood tree to open doorway to Bramblewood; party passed through petrified tree portal into central pathway. (MATT/MARISHA, turns 1076–1081)
From mist-form aerial view, party spotted a ~15–20 ft grassless dirt mound with wooden spikes, glimmering objects, grooves, and two people with a cart near Westruun. (MATT, turn 1115)
Investigation of offering site: sweeping claw marks indicate repeated large/fleet creature (dragon) retrieving offerings; Vex/Vax noticed. (MATT, turns 1119–1126)

Outer farmlands: some fields intentionally burned; armed guards watch working farmers; thin battlement/wall around city entrances. Vex/Vax/others observed and chose to descend and stealth approach; Pass Without a Trace cast by Vex; group succeeded high stealth. (MATT, turns 1132–1191)

Farmers near Westruun enslaved to supply city; guards/half-orcs enforce, abducting people (including Reginald's daughter). Farmer Reginald reports dragon flies by ~every couple days, last seen dusk yesterday; abducted people kept in city outskirts. (Turns 1197–1272)
Party debates intervention: risks—killing guards may prompt reprisals and city famine; consider gathering intel on who leads the abductors. (Turns 1198–1202, 1199, 1260–1262)
